assessments.reasoning: The Using Lexical Binding chapter identifies variables defined by defvar, defcustom or defconst as special and dynamically bound. The no-value defvar example shows lexical and dynamic bindings of the same variable in different regions.

challenge.method: Read the contrast between definitions and a local declaration with no value. Check the following special-variable-p description and the restriction on special variables as formal arguments.
challenge.results: A local no-value declaration can alter binding without the permanent special-variable property recognized by special-variable-p. The proposed claim allows that split and asserts no formal-argument rule.

limitations: The claim concerns dynamic binding under the documented lexical contexts and does not assert a compiler representation or broaden a local declaration's scope.
